name: GRT Probe
description: Tests whether GRT reduces incoming damage. Iron Tonic (a battle consumable that normally grants GRT +10) is amplified to GRT +150 and sold for 1 ring in every shop. Use it mid-battle, then let the same enemy hit you with the same move, and compare. If the damage taken drops, GRT is damage reduction. Nothing else differs from the playthrough build.

edits.text: TEST ITEM. Grants GRT +150 for the battle. Use it, then get hit by the same move, and compare.
